claim_one_line: I-26'S UNTOUCHED HALF PAID, AND THE ANSWER IS ABELIAN OR NOTHING. The identification ledger records that naming the surviving gauge group -- the centralizer of rho(pi_1) -- remains part of I-26's price and is UNTOUCHED, its other half having been paid at B1295. The corpus has not drawn the decisive distinction: B854 computes the centralizer of 2T, the FINITE McKay image, and gets an abelian u(1)^4, but the object's geometric holonomy is discrete and faithful, hence a lattice in PSL2(C), hence ZARISKI-DENSE by Borel density, so its centralizer is that of the whole SL2 and is strictly smaller. Computed exactly over Q on B854's E6 Chevalley algebra with its own controls re-run: Z(2T) has dim 4 and is abelian (rank 4, all six brackets vanish), Z(the geometric holonomy, i.e. of the principal sl2) has DIM 0, and the positive control Z(h) for the principal semisimple element has dim 6 = rank E6 as it must. THEOREM, needing no case analysis: for any H with 2T <= H <= SL2 principal, Z(H) is a subalgebra of the abelian Z(2T), hence abelian of dimension at most 4, while the Standard-Model algebra is NON-ABELIAN of dimension 12 -- so no flat connection with holonomy in the principal SL2 containing 2T leaves the Standard-Model algebra unbroken, whatever the holonomy. For I-26 this means the identification that reads dim H^1(M;27_rho) as a count of massless multiplets OF A GAUGE GROUP has no non-abelian group for the classes to be multiplets of: none of any size for the geometric holonomy, an abelian u(1)^4 at best for the finite 2T connection. I-26 is NOT earned and the ratchet does not move; it is made harder, and the row should record that the surviving group is now named and is abelian or trivial. SCOPE: this constrains the FLAT-CONNECTION route only -- the paper's Standard-Model algebra comes from the ninth closing Y_9, a closed manifold, and nothing here refutes that; it says the flat E6 connection cannot supply the group, so the closing must, and the h^1 readings on the cusped object cannot be multiplet counts. The embedding is I-25 and I-25 is UNEARNED, so all of this is for the PRINCIPAL sl2; other embeddings give other centralizers, B1303 having computed dim 2 for the regular A1A1A2, also far from 12 but not covered by the theorem.
